change_policy: This manifest and the deployment-standards-v1.0 tag are immutable historical records and must never be rewritten or moved. Post-freeze normative changes require normal governance and a versioned revision, new standard, supersession, or retirement. Documentation, harness, agent-layer, provenance, and conformance-audit changes land only as forward commits. No Deployment conformance audit had been performed before this baseline; therefore no Deployment known-evidence-index is part of v1.0. That intentional absence does not weaken the normative freeze.
